name: Jerónimos Monastery
description: Manueline stonework wraps this riverside monastery in Belém. The cloister is a quiet counterpoint to the busy waterfront.

name: Belém Tower
description: A fortified tower stands in the Tagus where ships once left for the Age of Discovery. Walk the bastion for river views.

name: Pena Palace
description: A colourful Romantic palace crowns a Sintra hill above forest parks. Bright façades and terraces look toward the Atlantic.

name: Clérigos Church and Tower
description: Porto’s baroque Clérigos tower rises above the old city. Climb for a 360-degree view of roofs and the Douro.

name: Lisbon Cathedral
description: The Sé of Lisbon mixes Romanesque fortress walls with later chapels. It anchors the Alfama slope above the river.

name: Alfama
description: Lisbon’s oldest district tumbles in alleys and miradouros above the Tagus. Fado houses and tiled façades fill the lanes.

name: Livraria Lello
description: A neo-Gothic bookshop famous for its crimson stair and stained glass. Timed entry helps manage the queues.

name: Ribeira district
description: Porto’s riverside quarter lines the Douro with colourful houses and cafés. Cross Dom Luís I bridge for the classic view.

name: Cabo da Roca
description: A cliff-top cape marks mainland Europe’s westernmost point. Windswept paths look straight onto the Atlantic.

name: Oceanário de Lisboa
description: A large aquarium in Parque das Nações groups ocean habitats around a vast central tank.

name: Time Out Market
description: A food hall in Cais do Sodré gathers Portuguese chefs and stalls under one roof. Share small plates at communal tables.

name: Mercado do Bolhão
description: Porto’s historic market hall sells fresh produce, fish and flowers. The renovated building keeps the open-court feel.

name: Pastéis de Belém
description: The bakery that popularised pastéis de nata still serves warm custard tarts beside the monastery. Expect a queue that moves quickly.

name: Pinhão wine terraces
description: Douro Valley terraces around Pinhão grow grapes for port and table wine. Quinta tastings pair river views with local bottles.

name: Café A Brasileira
description: A historic Chiado café known for bica coffee and its Pessoa statue outside. An easy stop between shops and tram rides.

name: Festas de Santo António
description: Lisbon’s June saint festivals fill Alfama with grilled sardines, marches and street parties for Santo António.
